items.text: In every panel the woman has full, long, wavy copper/auburn hair (no bald scalp or bald crown)
The trousers are blue denim jeans that fit tightly over the hips, seat and upper thighs and flare out wide below the knee (bell-bottoms)
The jeans show visible denim construction details such as contrast topstitching or pockets
The figure wears a mustard/yellow long-sleeve shirt with a large pointed collar
The panels show the same dressed figure standing, walking, seated with thighs horizontal, and with arms raised out to the sides
In no panel does bare skin of the body poke through the trousers or the shirt fabric
No garment shows torn holes, long pointed spikes, or detached floating pieces
